responseBinding.questionText: Paragraph A

rows.sourceExcerpt: Long before cheap paper and searchable databases, administrators needed durable ways to record obligations. One answer was the tally stick: a piece of wood marked with notches that represented a payment, delivery or debt. The system did not depend on elaborate writing.
